plugins.name: WorkBuddy Intl AutoPool CPA
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI provider for CN (copilot.tencent.com) and Global (codebuddy.ai) WorkBuddy accounts. Account pool with a minimum-available guarantee, in-plugin 429 / credit-exhaustion failover, per-model credit multiplier and promotion badges read live from the upstream catalog, per-model busy levels, real-volume per-model availability probes, per-model reasoning-effort and context-budget controls, daily CN check-in and Global 30-credit bonus, session affinity, admission control, JSONL credit/token logs, and an embedded management panel.
plugins.author: MengBad
